question: Does the broad opt=3 to opt=s compiler intervention improve the current guard protected normal-run latency, and how does the repaired archived reference respond in the same run?

builds.settings: Exact matched fresh builds described by windows-opt-level-builds-20261116-summary.json; within each source only CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL changed. Current all-features and reference intrinsic source/feature differences remain.

method.previous_failed_attempt: The prior consumed pre-SUT launcher attempt is preserved in windows-opt-level-readiness-20261116-summary.json and was not replayed or scored.
method.schedule: Four Williams rows repeated twice: c3 r3 rs cs / r3 cs c3 rs / cs rs r3 c3 / rs c3 cs r3
method.balance: Each arm twice per position; each directed within-block predecessor once per four-row cycle. Cross-block carryover remains.
method.workload: Same pinned fixture mark FILE 0.05, protected by --timeout2; payload sleep is included in elapsed.
method.endpoint: Parent CreateProcessW entry through original retained guard native wait; observer/marker acquisition overlaps payload startup and execution.
method.prior_exposures: The exact archived current-o3/current-os images were exercised by the just-completed full guard/auto/battery suites; the new repaired-reference images were not exercised by those suites. Exact SUT invocation counts were not logged. All images were read and hashed before launch. Four equal within-call qualifications are excluded and disclosed; they do not establish equal prior cache/history. No cold or intrinsic-causal comparison is claimed.

runtime_observations.first_payload_sample: The first retained original-payload zero-time poll after the guard native completion returned0 in every slot. This proves terminal at that observed sample; it does not identify the exact termination instant.
runtime_observations.source_integer_identity_parsing: Lossless FILETIME and file-ID comparisons; original decimal bytes unchanged.

decision.reason: The current opt=s minus opt3 paired block median is +1637400ns and positive6/8; its mean is -468425ns and marginal arm medians point the other way. This sample does not establish a dependable improvement and does not justify promotion.
decision.current_default_minus_reference_o3: Paired block median+2423500ns, positive5/8; this diagnostic does not pass the speed requirement.

limits: Four fixed qualification slots c3,r3,rs,cs precede measurement; all four must pass original protected custody. They are excluded from eight measured Williams blocks. Any failure stops; preserve raw partials and do not restart or replace slots.

Eight fixed four-arm Williams blocks repeat four rows twice, 32 measured slots. Each arm appears twice in each position and each directed predecessor occurs once per four-block cycle within blocks; cross-block carryover remains.

The same pinned testkit executes mark FILE 0.05. Original guard and payload PID/creation image/Job/first terminal/empty I/O/deadline/cleanup oracles remain required, using published native share READ|WRITE|DELETE marker reader and no trace environment.

Elapsed includes parent CreateProcessW through original retained guard native wait and overlaps marker acquisition and 50ms payload. Separate phase intervals are observer-influenced and not exclusive component costs.

Predeclare per-block current-reference at opt3 and opts, within-source opts-opt3, and descriptive difference-in-differences. Medians/order strata are descriptive, not isolated compiler, image-size, loader, CPU, security, product-default or primary speed acceptance.
Four archived PE paths and file identities differ; path/cache/AV/scheduler and source feature/resource graph can affect outcomes. Reference is not generally eligible (prior G28 failure).
2s product timeout, 3s slot bound, retained original 55s root/60s backup with 11s reserve; no watchdog/trusted assistance qualifies. Root outer finite Job remains required.
No prior exposures are labeled cold or deleted; current/repaired-reference historical observations stay separate.
Prior namespace001 failed strict root guard argv before any qualification or product call; preserved and excluded, not a warmup or measured slot.
All eight blocks and all large observations are retained. No trimming, significance-based equivalence, favorable retry, pooled historical epochs or aggregate win-rate claim.

Means, medians and marginal arm medians can point in different directions; the within-block contrasts are the predeclared summaries. Eight blocks are descriptive, not an academic primary performance qualification.
The compiler intervention affects broad code generation, inlining and layout. This does not isolate image size, loader work, CPU cost or a source-level slowdown cause.
The archived reference passed this narrow protected normal workload; its prior broader G28 qualification failure remains unresolved and it is not generally eligible as a correctness baseline.

Current-image readiness was600 top-level existing test function executions with five guard conditional assertions not exercised and two timing functions filtered per battery. This does not certify all protections under opt=s.
Exact machine/transport/identity raw originals remain private; this numeric summary and hashes are not the complete public academic reproducibility package.
